subject: Nanotechnology
title: Optical Antennas
description: Learn Optical Antennas in one minute.

hook.text: Radio antennas convert waves to current — nano optical antennas do the same for visible light.

buildup.text: Metal nanostructures concentrate light into hotspots far smaller than the wavelength — boosting local fields.

discovery.text: A bowtie antenna — two triangles tip-to-tip — focuses light into a gap as small as 5 nm.

twist.text: Intense local heating can melt the antenna tip — thermal management limits how much power you can focus.

climax.text: Optical antennas enhance single-molecule fluorescence — making one molecule visible that would otherwise vanish.

punchline.text: Shrink an antenna to nanoscale and it catches light, not radio.

quiz.question: What do nano optical antennas do?
options: They transmit radio signals at optical frequencies
They concentrate light into hotspots far smaller than the wavelength
They convert light directly into electrical power like solar cells
